title: Second Thread
challenge: A label turning deadstock and offcut fabric into limited runs of clothing. The story was strong, but the brand looked like a craft project and couldn’t hold its price beside premium fashion.
insight: The customers it wanted bought on craft and scarcity first. Sustainability was the reason to trust the label, not the reason to buy.
idea: We positioned Second Thread as a premium label that happens to waste nothing. A refined identity, numbered tags that trace each fabric’s history, and mailers made from the same offcuts as the clothes.
outcome: A label that sells on desire and proves its values in the details.
